setting.description: Determines if the Turnitin Core API plugin is active for the journal.
setting.name: turnitin_enabled

setting.description: The base URL of your Turnitin Core API tenant, e.g. https://your-tenant.turnitin.com
setting.name: turnitin_api_url

setting.description: The API key registered for this integration in the Turnitin admin console.
setting.name: turnitin_api_key

setting.description: Whether the Turnitin tenant requires EULA acceptance, as reported by the Get Features Enabled request (tenant.require_eula): 'true' or 'false', or blank if it has not been fetched yet. Set automatically when the API URL and key are saved.
setting.name: turnitin_require_eula

setting.description: When on, submissions are added to the Turnitin index (add_to_index) and may be compared against future submissions.
setting.name: turnitin_index_submissions
setting.pretty_name: Add submissions to your iThenticate repository for future comparison

setting.description: When on, changes an editor makes in the iThenticate report viewer are saved for the next time the report is opened (save_changes), and Turnitin sends a SIMILARITY_UPDATED webhook if the overall match percentage changes.
setting.name: turnitin_save_report_changes

setting.description: Base64 signing secret used to verify the signature of incoming Turnitin webhooks. Generated automatically when the webhook is registered.
setting.name: turnitin_webhook_secret

setting.description: The ID of the webhook registered with Turnitin. Set automatically when the webhook is registered.
setting.name: turnitin_webhook_id

setting.description: Optional override for the callback URL registered with Turnitin. Leave blank to use this install's webhook URL. Set this to a tunnel URL (e.g. https://abc123.ngrok-free.app/plugins/turnitin-core-api/webhook/) to receive callbacks during development.
setting.name: turnitin_webhook_url

setting.description: Leave text in quotation marks out of the similarity score. Sent as exclude_quotes when a report is generated; editors can still change it in the report viewer.
setting.name: turnitin_exclude_quotes

setting.description: Leave the reference list out of the similarity score. Sent as exclude_bibliography when a report is generated; editors can still change it in the report viewer.
setting.name: turnitin_exclude_bibliography

setting.description: Leave in-text citations out of the similarity score. Sent as exclude_citations when a report is generated; editors can still change it in the report viewer.
setting.name: turnitin_exclude_citations

setting.description: Leave the abstract out of the similarity score. Sent as exclude_abstract when a report is generated; editors can still change it in the report viewer.
setting.name: turnitin_exclude_abstract

setting.description: Leave the methods section out of the similarity score. Sent as exclude_methods when a report is generated; editors can still change it in the report viewer.
setting.name: turnitin_exclude_methods

setting.description: Leave out the custom sections defined in your iThenticate account. Sent as exclude_custom_sections when a report is generated; editors can still change it in the report viewer.
setting.name: turnitin_exclude_custom_sections

setting.description: Leave matches against preprints out of the similarity score. Sent as exclude_preprints when a report is generated; editors can still change it in the report viewer.
setting.name: turnitin_exclude_preprints

setting.description: Leave matches shorter than the word count below out of the similarity score. Sent as exclude_small_matches when a report is generated; editors can still change it in the report viewer.
setting.name: turnitin_exclude_small_matches

setting.description: The minimum number of words a match must have to count when small matches are excluded (exclude_small_matches). Turnitin's minimum is 8.
setting.name: turnitin_small_match_words
